title: Keep input-dependent record leakage in the full recovery objective
statement: For a qubit trace-decreasing branch with PTM[[a,b^T],[c,T]] and CPTP receiver[[1,0],[t,R]], full Bell-fidelity contribution is(a+b dot t+Tr RT)/4. For a fixed qubit record POVM, the maximum CPTP-versus-conditional-unitary premium over compatible instruments equals L/4, L=sum_s||b_s||=min_constant-record K ||M_record-K||diamond. Bell input attains the record norm; the erased-output instrument attains the premium.
